welcome.title: 🚀 Welcome to Your Command Center
welcome.desc: Your Vocalize dashboard transforms guest feedback into actionable business intelligence. We'll walk you through the key features in about 90 seconds.

header_branch.title: 🏢 Branch Selector
header_branch.desc: Switch between branches or select 'All Branches' for a consolidated view. Every chart, KPI card, and report on the dashboard adapts instantly to your selection.

header_qr.title: 📊 QR Scan Counter
header_qr.desc: This counter shows how many times your QR codes and feedback links have been scanned in the selected period. A high scan count with low feedback means your form might need optimization.

header_notifications.title: 🔔 Real-Time Notifications
header_notifications.desc: Instant alerts for new feedbacks, urgent complaints, and system updates. Red badges indicate unread critical items that need immediate attention.

feedbacks.title: 🚨 Urgent Feedback Banner
feedbacks.desc: This red banner appears when a guest is still at the table and needs help NOW. Acting within minutes can turn a negative experience into a loyal customer. Click 'Inspect' to jump directly to urgent items.

dashboard_kpi.title: 📈 Dashboard KPI Cards
dashboard_kpi.desc: Your daily performance snapshot: total feedbacks, satisfaction score, resolution rate, and more. Green arrows indicate improvement over the previous period; red arrows indicate decline.

dashboard_charts.title: 📊 Quick Look Charts
dashboard_charts.desc: These charts summarize your business's overall satisfaction trend, complaint distribution, and traffic sources on a single screen.

dashboard_activities.title: 📋 Recent Activities
dashboard_activities.desc: Watch the pulse of your business here. Recent guest interactions from all platforms are shown in real-time.

sidebar_feedbacks.title: 💬 Feedback Management
sidebar_feedbacks.desc: Your central hub for all guest messages. Let's navigate there now to explore the filtering, detail views, and customer intelligence features.

feedbacks_filters.title: 🎯 Smart Filters
feedbacks_filters.desc: Narrow down feedbacks by Status (New, Pending, Resolved...), Type (Complaint, Suggestion, Evaluation), or Flags (VIP, Sensitive). Use 'Show Urgent Only' checkbox to instantly surface critical items.

feedbacks_date.title: 📅 Date Range Picker
feedbacks_date.desc: Analyze any time period: today, this week, this month, or a custom range. Compare performance across different periods to spot trends and seasonal patterns.

feedback_search.title: 🔍 Search Bar
feedback_search.desc: Search feedbacks by customer name, message content, or reference ID. Useful when a customer contacts you and you need to find their feedback quickly.

feedback_card_anatomy.title: 🃏 Feedback Card & Details
feedback_card_anatomy.desc: Clicking on cards opens the detailed feedback modal and customer profile. If you see the customer's name in blue, it means there is a special staff/business note attached to that customer's profile.

sidebar_analytics.title: 📊 Detailed Analytics
sidebar_analytics.desc: Deep-dive into performance metrics, demographic insights, and branch comparisons. Let's navigate there now...

analytics_kpi.title: 📊 Analytics KPI Cards
analytics_kpi.desc: Four key metrics at a glance: Total Interactions, Unique Users, Loyalty Score (out of 100), and Operational Performance (resolution rate vs. pending complaints). Compare with the previous period to track progress.

analytics_trend.title: 📈 Trend & Forecasting
analytics_trend.desc: Monitor daily feedback volume over time. Switch between 'General' (total count) and 'Detailed' (Complaint/Suggestion/Evaluation breakdown) views. If complaints spike on certain days, investigate staffing or supply chain issues.

analytics_brand_experience.title: ⚡ Brand Experience & Perception
analytics_brand_experience.desc: This analysis measures the balance between your guests' overall brand perception and their instant satisfaction during recent visits, helping you identify potential expectation gaps.

analytics_hourly.title: ⏰ Hourly Activity Analysis
analytics_hourly.desc: Discover your peak hours. Switch between 'Age Distribution' and 'Form Type' tabs to understand WHO is visiting WHEN. The Peak Insights cards below reveal your busiest day, hour, age group, and dominant feedback type.

analytics_detailed.title: 👥 Demographic Intelligence
analytics_detailed.desc: Understand your audience: age distribution, satisfaction by age group, and feedback type breakdown. Use this data to tailor your marketing and service strategies to your most active customer segments.

league.title: 🏆 Branch Performance League
league.desc: All your branches ranked by the Vocalize Score — a composite of Quality (40%), Operational Efficiency (30%), and Traffic Share (30%). You can track the overall competition directly from this list.

league_inspect.title: 🔍 Inspecting the Leader
league_inspect.desc: Clicking on any row to detail its success opens the Branch Performance Report Card, which includes AI diagnosis and comprehensive branch-specific reports.

branch_intelligence.title: AI Branch Diagnosis
branch_intelligence.desc: In this area prepared specifically for each branch, performance is summarized in a single sentence by blending Google Maps interactions, operational speed, and customer satisfaction data.

branch_hourly.title: 📊 Branch Hourly Activity
branch_hourly.desc: This branch's activity heatmap by hour. Identify peak times to optimize staffing, and compare age vs. feedback type distributions to understand visitor patterns specific to this location.

branch_demographics.title: 👥 Branch Customer Profile
branch_demographics.desc: Who visits this specific branch? See age distribution and satisfaction scores by age group. Use this to develop location-specific promotions and service adjustments.

smart_insights.title: 🧠 Vocalize Smart Analysis
smart_insights.desc: AI-driven strategic analysis of your branch performance. Smart Diagnoses detect operational blind spots, highlight strengths, and provide actionable recommendations. This is your personal business consultant powered by data.

finish.title: 🎉 You're All Set!
finish.desc: Your Vocalize Command Center is ready. Start turning guest feedback into competitive advantage. You can restart this tour anytime from Settings → 'Restart Tutorial'.
